title: Figure 3: spherical radiation shield surrounding a point source
description: Diagram of a blue sphere labelled "Radiation Shielding Material" with a red starburst point source at the centre, a radius r extending to a stick-figure person outside, and the note "μ = attenuation coefficient." Below is a small graph of flux ratio Φ(r)/Φinitial decaying exponentially with r. Captioned "Figure 3. Spherical Radiation Shield Surrounding a Point Source," illustrating attenuation equation 1.17 in a discussion of spacecraft radiation shielding.
